name: NOTICE OF CONTINUANCE - REVISIONS TO COMMUNITY SERVICES FEES AND POLICIES FOR ATHLETICS AND AQUATICS
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF CONTINUATION OF
  PUBLIC HEARING
Christina Shea
Mayor
  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that at its regular meeting

Mayor Pro Tempore  public hearing relative to the REVISIONS TO
Michael C. Carroll
  COMMUNITY SERVICES FEES AND POLICIES FOR
Councilmember  ATHLETICS AND AQUATICS to a date yet to be
  determined to hear public comments regarding the
Melissa Fox
Councilmember
  proposed actions.

Councilmember
